messages:
maria: heads-up — new org (acadia-llm) is ready for provisioning. need GPU quota requests + billing/tagging plan before we create projects.

samir: thanks. which clouds/regions are they expecting?

maria: primary: aws us-west-2 (for Dedicated pools), backup gcp europe-west1 for DR. small pilot: 4x A10G, then scale to 20x A100 if pilot validates.

alex: noted. we should preflight: IAM roles, billing account link, org-level tag policy, subnet IP limits, and egress quotas. also check service quota for ENIs in us-west-2 (we hit limits last month).

jen: +1. can we follow the usual request template? I pasted a trimmed example: ```
Cloud: AWS
Account: acct-acadia-prod
Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1
Quota requests:
 - A10G (p4d?) count: initial 4 -> target 20 (us-west-2)
 - A100 (p4) count: reserve 20 (on approval)
 - Elastic IPs: 10
 - ENIs: 500
 - VPC route table entries: 200
 - Nat Gateway egress: 10 Gbps
Owner: maria@redwood.ai
Business justification: inference pilot for customer X — latency-sensitive, reserved capacity
Lead time preferred: 2 weeks
Escalation: cloud-ops@redwood.ai
```

infra-bot: automated-check: aws us-west-2 A100 quota = 0, A10G quota = 8 (available), ENI limit = 350 (used 320). Recommend opening support case for A100 and ENI bump.

samir: can we reuse the org-level tag policy from `redwood-core`? need cost center, team, project, env tags enforced. tag keys: [cost_center, team, project, env, owner].

maria: yes reuse and add `model_stage` (pilot|prod). Also require `data_classification`. add to request notes.

alex: on IAM, create two roles per cloud: infra-admin (for SRE/provisioning) and infra-viewer (for billing/observability). Use CLIs below to create service account prototypes: ```
# AWS (example)
aws iam create-role --role-name infra-admin-acadia --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name infra-admin-acadia --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess

# GCP (example)
gcloud iam roles create infraAdminAcadia --project=acct-acadia-prod --file=role-def.yaml
```

jen: timeline? I'll open the provider cases today for A100 + ENI. expect initial approvals in ~5-10 business days but A100 could be longer depending on region.

cloud-ops: if A100 lead time slips, fallback plan: reserve additional A10G nodes + enable quantized model profiles to reduce GPU memory. also consider provisioning Dedicated in eu-west-1 while waiting.

maria: good. next actions:
 - jen: open AWS support cases (A100, ENI, EIP) and link billing account
 - samir: clone tag policy & PR to infra-config repo
 - alex: prototyped IAM roles & terraform module for project bootstrap
 - cloud-ops: prepare fallback sizing for A10G
I'll reconvene Fri EOD. :thumbsup:

samir: noted, will PR today.

jen: support cases opened: case #12345678 (A100), #12345679 (ENI). added details and `model_stage` tag requirement. will update when ticket progresses.

infra-bot: ticket update: #12345678 status = pending review by AWS quota team. ETA 7 business days.

maria: thanks everyone — documenting final checklist in the onboarding doc and will attach ticket links.

alex: added terraform bootstrap module draft to `infra-config` repo, tagging it `acadia-bootstrap-v1`.

maria: closing thread for now, will post follow-ups in project channel.
